description.value: A cross-sectional structural MRI study examining associations between adolescent and early-adult cannabis use and cortical surface morphology, gyrification, cortical thickness, and regional gray matter volumes.

spans.text: In this study, we examined the possible influence of cannabis use on adolescence and early-adulthood brain development through the analysis of cortical surface morphology measures, including gyrification indices, cortical thickness, and regional gray matter volumes.
